links.outcome: Patient views on how much information about AI should be provided
links.effect: Patients wanted information about AI proportional to the consequences; written information should be informative but concise, avoiding details that create confusion.
links.quote: If written information about AI is provided, it should be informative but concise, avoiding details that generate more confusion than clarity.

unlisted_practices: Emphasizing clinician empathy and human presence alongside AI-assisted colonoscopy to preserve patient trust

screen.reason: Qualitative study exploring patient attitudes and experiences following real-time AI-assisted colonoscopy.
